newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan LDP says may summon DKB officials to Diet.
newsitem.headline: Japan LDP says may summon DKB officials to Diet.

text.p: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) is considering asking Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) executives to attend parliament to respond to questioning, LDP officials said on Tuesday.
Details on who would be summoned for questioning will be discussed later, he said.
DKB, the world's third largest bank in terms of assets, was raided by prosecutors on Tuesday as part of a widening investigation into links between racketeers and the world of finance.
DKB said that it regretted the raid, but stayed silent over reports that it provided questionable loans to the racketeer at the centre of the Nomura Securities Co Ltd payoff scandal, Ryuichi Koike.
